description.content:
Creates a Retrieve Booking details request for a specific Booking Id


The response contains booking level as well as item level action links to approve/deny the booking request. The approve/deny action links will be coming in the response when approval status is PENDING and booking status is BOOKED.


Request Parameters

Attribute Type Description
metadata

item.name: Cancel booking item for a particular booking

request.name: Cancel booking item for a particular booking

description.content:
Creates a cancel request to cancel a particular booking item present in the booking.

Request Parameters

Attribute Type Description
metadata
bookingId String Booking id corresponding to each booked product
itemId String Booking item id corresponding to booking item which we want to cancel

Response Parameters in case of successful response

Attribute Type Description
metadata
booking_id String Booking id corresponding to the booking which is to be cancelled
status String SUCCESS
id String Booking item id which is to be cancelled

Below response with 200 OK HttpStatus

    
    {
        "booking_id": "123",
        "status": "SUCCESS",
        "id": "1",
    }

Response Parameters in case of failure response

Attribute Type Description
metadata
booking_id String Booking id corresponding to the booking which is to be cancelled
status String FAILURE
error_code String Error code in case of cancellation
error_message String Error message in case of cancellation
id String Booking item id which is to be cancelled

Below response with 500 Internal Server Error HttpStatus

    
    {
        "booking_id": "123",
        "status": "FAILURE",
        "id": "1234",
        "error_code": "EGE-ER-OS-5011",
        "error_message": "There was an error in cancelling the [1234] items. Please try again.",
    }
